title: FailureRecoveryReport
description: The Failure Recovery agent's structured proposal. Validated by steps/failure_recovery_step.py against environment/incidents.py: validate_recovery_proposal is a hard gate (reroute_proposals must cover exactly the affected task ids, each exactly once); reroutes_avoid_source_machine is a soft flag (a reroute back onto the same machine a task was just displaced from fixes nothing, but isn't itself a structural error). On success this is sent as a reroute_request message to the resource_allocation mailbox for re-validation against the same constraint gate Resource Allocation's own proposals use (steps/resource_allocation_step.py::run_reroute_validation_step) -- no second LLM negotiation on that side.

incidents.description: Must be copied exactly from IncidentReportFact.incidents.

new_machine_id.description: Should differ from the task's current (incident) machine_id.
